name: query_video_metrics
description: Query a completed day of retained danmaku counts by video_id; videos and live rooms share the same ID and semantics. Only authorized IDs are allowed

video_id.description: Authorized video/room ID from confirmed_conditions or the current validated page; do not substitute a historical video.

date.description: Completed business day in Asia/Shanghai, formatted YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-10-31). Use the frozen date; yesterday is businessDate minus one day. Not a timestamp or playback position.

metric.description: Metric identifier; currently only bullet_count (retained danmaku count). Do not replace it with a display label or unsupported metric.
